scope: Previously seen hard photographic research after both model numerical gates pass; no product integration or weight redistribution.
numericalPrerequisites: Passed same-graph global/local synthetic receipts with unchanged FP32 and one-byte R8 bounds; every live session re-audited before model execution.
preparationBackend: Explicitly selected original native Torch CPU preparation, padding, interpolation, skip decisions and overlap composition for research only; no CPU learned model is constructed or executed.
learnedInferenceBackend: Native ONNX Runtime WebGPU with pre-audited bounded CPU dimension bookkeeping only; no image-inference CPU fallback or retry.
algorithm: Unmodified upstream process_high_res_im and safe_forward; fast=false, L=900, BGR input and original normalization, thresholds, overlap order and truncating R8 conversion.
inputs: Reuse earlier hash-verified full-native neutral SDR prepared sources and frozen SAM baselines, no crop/lens/local edits.
qualityGate: Useful fine boundaries without material regression, new excluded-object contamination, missing legs or incorrect semantic coverage; broad adoption still requires the original full twelve-scene gate.
stop: Stop photographic expansion after a decisive hard-case failure; preserve that output and do not tune prompts, thresholds, weights or operators.
outputs: Fresh private native R8 masks, hashes, per-call live-session audit and provider profiles; image quality never inferred from numerical checks.
